note: Every claim carries its source and hash. A claim whose status is not VERIFIED or MEASURED may not appear in the narration. No number here comes from a document alone; each was re-derived on 2026-11-02 from the artifact or receipt named in the claim, and the source hashes below bind the exact bytes that were read.

claims.spoken_as: 这条视频，二十一项检查全过。
claims.statement: The rejected cut passed 21 automated checks with 0 fail and 0 warn.

supporting.note: the per-check severities: 19 PASS, 2 INFO, 0 FAIL, 0 WARN

claims.usage_scope: technical checks only, for this one run
claims.caveat: Does not mean visual, aesthetic, voice-naturalness or factual quality passed. Those are the reasons it was rejected. The receipt records 21 entries, of which 19 are PASS and 2 are INFO (the video header and the voice-quality declaration, which itself carries production_quality_warning=true). '21' is the receipt's auto_qc_checks field, not the number of checks in qc_video.py, which has 22 conditional checks.append sites. The two numbers must not be quoted as the same measurement.

claims.statement: The graded artifact is 62.0 s, 1080x1920, six shots, all with motion: static.

claims.spoken_as: 实测六十二秒里，六十秒是静止的。
claims.statement: At least 60.10 s of the 62.0 s (>=96.9%) is near-static. freezedetect reports 12 completed freeze runs; a 13th freeze starts at 60.5 s and reaches EOF without a freeze_duration line.

measurements.trailing_note: The 13th freeze begins at 60.5 s and is interrupted by EOF, so freezedetect emits no freeze_duration for it. 60.10 s is the sum of the 12 completed runs and is therefore a lower bound on near-static time. The narration rounds down to 'sixty seconds' and must never be stated as an upper bound or as an exact total.

claims.usage_scope: this 62 s artifact, under these exact freeze parameters
claims.caveat: Must not be generalised to other Easel videos, to this repository, or to AI video in general. The number depends on the freezedetect thresholds, and the reported 96.9% excludes the final freeze run that ends at EOF.

claims.spoken_as: 没有一项在问：画面到底动没动。
claims.statement: scripts/qc_video.py contains no freeze or motion measurement.
claims.method: grep -Ei 'freezedetect|freeze|motion|ssim|psnr' scripts/qc_video.py returns 0 matches. The file has 22 checks.append sites, several of them conditional; the recorded run's receipt has 21 entries (19 PASS, 2 INFO). The checks cover existence, size, ffprobe parse, resolution, aspect, duration, codec, audio presence and codec, project.yaml, source refs, captions, script, storyboard, real-source ratio, provenance, engine, silence, subtitle burn, real evidence and voice-quality declaration. None measures inter-frame motion, held composition time, on-screen text height, black-area share or safe areas.
claims.usage_scope: states what the current implementation measures, not what all QC could measure
claims.caveat: Saying 'no check measures motion' is about this file today. It is not a claim that motion cannot be measured, and the 22 append sites are not the same count as the receipt's 21 entries.

claims.spoken_as: 更讽刺的是，这个能力我们其实已经有了。六个动效工程就在仓库里，重新渲出来，和原片几乎看不出差别。
claims.statement: Six HyperFrames compositions re-render from source with visual equivalence to the committed clips.
claims.usage_scope: demonstrates that the compositions regenerate; not evidence about the rejected video's content
claims.caveat: Visual equivalence, not byte reproduction. The renderer version differs from the pin, so this is stated as equivalence and never as 'identical'.

claims.spoken_as: 是我们把质检通过，当成了可以发布。
claims.statement: The Founder rejected the cut on picture, motion, style and voice, while automated QC passed.
claims.usage_scope: the recorded reason for this rejection
claims.caveat: The rejection is qualitative; scores are null. Quote it as a decision, not as a measured score.

claims.spoken_as: 你觉得，AI 视频最容易露馅的，是画面还是配音？
claims.statement: A question to the audience. Not a factual claim.
